item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["ad32fd3603826d4835ec"],"operation":"Report an object-member type error during json_vunpack_ex.","condition":"A keyed member has the wrong type and an error output is supplied.","capability":"Pass the member key to typed validation and include it in the diagnostic.","consequence":"The error cannot identify the member key.","equivalence_reason":"Unique diagnostic target and error-output condition."},{"member_ids":["06cf0d184f6c9f73c0e0"],"operation":"Unpack a scalar using s, i, I, b, f, F, or n.","condition":"A type-specific scalar format is selected.","capability":"Validate and extract the corresponding JSON scalar type.","consequence":"Scalar extraction or type-mismatch rejection fails.","equivalence_reason":"Unique typed scalar operation."},{"member_ids":["d97b1176a6e9fb6ab068"],"operation":"Look up a required object member during unpacking.","condition":"The required member is absent.","capability":"Return the item-not-found result.","consequence":"The missing required member is not reported as item-not-found.","equivalence_reason":"Unique required-member condition."},{"member_ids":["1747dd53bcb247d1c2b1"],"operation":"Unpack an object in strict mode.","condition":"The JSON object has members unaccessed by the format.","capability":"Reject unaccessed members when ! or strict flags select strictness.","consequence":"Extra members are accepted.","equivalence_reason":"Unique strict-object check."},{"member_ids":["26c2a868ff015a3335ab"],"operation":"Unpack an array element requested by the format.","condition":"The requested index is absent.","capability":"Return the index-out-of-range result.","consequence":"The absent element is not reported as out of range.","equivalence_reason":"Unique array-index condition."},{"member_ids":["46f551a50b8c9de6ec4b"],"operation":"Unpack a value with O.","condition":"The O ownership format is selected.","capability":"Increment the extracted value's reference count.","consequence":"The returned value lacks the required owned reference.","equivalence_reason":"Unique reference-ownership operation."},{"member_ids":["a001e996b13d90734cc8"],"operation":"Unpack a root using an object or array format.","condition":"The nonnull root has the wrong container type.","capability":"Reject the container type mismatch.","consequence":"A mismatched root is accepted or mishandled.","equivalence_reason":"Unique root-container mismatch target."}]}
